messages:
maya-cs: Quick check-in on Boreal private VPC onboarding — last night's smoke ran but we saw dropped traffic from their analytics cluster to our inference endpoint. Putting a soft renewal risk flag until we clear cutover blockers :warning:
nitin-ops: saw that. NAT gateway metrics spiked then leveled. Their peering ACEs look fine. I think it's either SG or a route propagation delay. @priya-sec can you confirm the cross-account role for the logging lambda?
priya-sec: confirming — their IAM role (boreal-priv-log-writer) is in place but missing the kms:Decrypt grant for our key alias/redwood/boreal-logs. Added as action item. Also noticed their key policy blocks external principals — we need a grant not a policy change.
alex-sre: provisional repro steps I ran:
```
# from their bastion
curl -v https://inference.redwood-prod.internal/health
-> TLS handshake ok
-> TCP retransmits ~30% during handshake
```
Looks like intermittent packet loss between AZs. Could be MTU or firewall.
nitin-ops: thanks. Can we try adding a temporary route for the analytics subnet via our transit gw to see if it stabilizes? I'll stand up a test route and TTL it to 1 hour.
tara-pm: FYI CS health score drops if we hit >48h to cutover; customer mentioned procurement renewal call next week. We should prioritize fixes and collect evidence to show progress.
maya-cs: agreed. Priority list: 1) temporary test route (nitin) 2) KMS grant (priya) 3) capture pcap + tcpdump during test (alex) 4) sample audit logs to validate retention/format (nitin + priy a) 5) run final smoke and capture latency graph (alex).
priya-sec: created grant request, got this error from KMS console: "Grant creation failed: external principal not in same account." I'm going to open a ticket with infra to request cross-account grant — tagging deploy-bot to create infra ticket.
deploy-bot: [ticket-created] INFRA-8672: cross-account KMS grant request for boreal (owner=priya-sec, due=1765432600).
nitin-ops: temporary workaround: we can route their log sink to an S3 bucket in their account, and have them ship to our ingestion via signed URL — reduces dependency on cross-account KMS for now. Would that satisfy compliance? @priya-sec
priya-sec: possibly for short-term. Confirming with compliance — we need an audit trail proving we only read encrypted objects after customer consent. Requesting sample log blob for validation.
alex-sre: I'll attach pcaps and a 1h grafana snapshot after I run a TTL route test. Planning to do test at 11:30 PST.
maya-cs: can each owner drop a one-line status update after their task completes so I can assemble the executive update for the renewal call? I'll draft the email and share before EOD. :pray:
nitin-ops: will do. route added at 11:30, TTL 1h, monitoring on.
priya-sec: grant ticket submitted, compliance loop started, asked customer for a sample encrypted log blob.
alex-sre: tcpdump + grafana attached to ticket INFRA-8672 (will paste link when available). Saw MTU mismatch on one path (jumbo frames), lowering MTU on their ENI fixed retransmits in test.
tara-pm: excellent. I'll update the renewal tracker and mark mitigation in progress. If all clears we move from "at-risk" -> "watch".
maya-cs: thanks team. Post-mortem notes: capture steps we took, timeboxed work, customer feedback on onboarding docs (they struggled with KMS grant flow). Action: add a short doc to our private-deploy runbook explaining cross-account grant vs key policy differences. Assigning to @priya-sec to draft.
priya-sec: will do, aiming for a 1-pager by tomorrow.
maya-cs: closing thread after final smoke at 12:45 PST. If anything pops up ping me directly. :thumbsup:
